change: On macOS, path-based stat uses std::fs::metadata and Unix MetadataExt. Non-macOS stat and every target's fstat remain on their existing implementation. Both representations share the same NodeStatus field and kind conversion.

source_evidence.call: library/std/src/sys/fs/unix.rs imports libc::stat as stat64 for Apple targets. stat at line 1964 performs a single cvt(stat64(...)) outside the Linux-GNU statx cfg, without an EINTR retry loop.
source_evidence.record: FileAttr::from_stat64 retains the record unchanged on Apple. os/darwin/fs.rs MetadataExt reads st_mode, st_size, st_ctime and st_blksize directly with the same casts used by the existing toolkit conversion.
source_evidence.alternative: Pinned rustix 1.1.5 adjusts negative Apple timestamp nanoseconds and seconds; it is not used for this replacement because NodeStatus exposes raw st_ctime seconds.
source_evidence.path: The existing c_path truncation and native_path conversion are retained, so interior NUL suffixes are discarded before metadata is called.

validation.baseline: Two additional kind/error fixtures passed on Linux before implementation; three existing status fixtures were already integrated by #127.
